description: Who won an RFWIN prize draw. Use when someone asks "who won the … giveaway/contest/draw?" and has an RFWIN proof link (rfwin.uk/d/<id>) or draw id. Returns title, organiser/station and show, draw date, entry count, prizes, the winners and ordered backup winners (names masked for privacy, quote them exactly), the fairness verdict and a ready-to-quote answer. Free, no key.
